title: Known-object test, TOI-3500.02
summary: Known-object test on TOI-3500.02: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, ≤2.5, 3, ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 1%, 1%, 1%, 1% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 185 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 4 light curve(s), forming 44 distinct event(s), 21 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460757.1825 (ΔT 700.53 d); 8 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
